856-2292-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6797-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6797-8319.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-4460-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

813-2320-2955.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Justiciar's Portal.
813-2320-2955.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and giving it first strike until end of turn, and putting Justiciar's Portal into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Justiciar's Portal to your hand.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4549-4699.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-4699.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-2393-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-2393-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1594-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

3690-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3690-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Sylvan Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

360-1594-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-1594-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4200-6867-6967-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-3033-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7322.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2116-4050-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

240-4050-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-4369-5905.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-4369-5905.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Warleader's Call triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

4934-5078-5645.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2893-3470-5455-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4288-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4288-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

560-1563-2457-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Soldier by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

628-3108-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability
Repeat.
628-3108-5315.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-5223-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2034-2308-5933.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5933.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4394-4875-5231-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ghired, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2043-4772-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing the Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

1793-3967-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1793-3967-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2-914-1170-1562.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
2-914-1170-1562.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy spell, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ancestral Statue that's still an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger from step 5, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens, and you may blink any other nonland permanent using Displacer Kitten's trigger.

2557-2665-2743.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3774-4003-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Mu Yanling has at least ten loyalty counters on it.
Luxior attached to Mu Yanling.
3774-4003-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Mu Yanling.
Activate Mu Yanling's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

703-1562.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, targeting Machine God's Effigy.
Use Machine God's Effigy's ability to have both tokens instead enter as noncreature artifact token copies of Astral Dragon with "{T}: Add {U}".
Both Astral Dragon copies trigger.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times, creating an additional Astral Dragon trigger on the stack each loop.
Once you have infinite Astral Dragon triggers, resolve them all, creating infinite copies of all noncreature permanents that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
You may also target Machine God's Effigy any number of times to create infinite noncreature artifact copies of all creatures.

1728-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tuktuk the Explorer, adding {C}{C}.
Tuktuk the Explorer dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Tuktuk the Explorer trigger, creating a 5/5 Tuktuk the Returned artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tuktuk the Returned, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Tuktuk the Explorer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

364-1987-2556-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
